    Create interactive and/or static pollution maps

    render_pollution_map.Rd

    Main function to create Leaflet maps showing air pollution data with optional schools overlay. Generates both interactive HTML maps and static JPG exports.

    Usage

    render_pollution_map(
  data_sources = NULL,
  data_ids = NULL,
  data_symbols = NULL,
  data_dynamic = NULL,
  output_file = "pollution_map.html",
  export_image = NULL,
  boroughs = NULL,
  pollutant = "no2",
  display_times = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  vignette = NULL,
  colour_scale = "who_no2",
  styling_type = "html",
  marker_labels = NULL,
  banner_colour = NULL,
  boundary_labels = NULL,
  autoplay = NULL,
  play_speed = NULL,
  theme_file = NULL,
  wind = NULL
)

    Arguments

    data_sources

    List of file paths or sf objects. Files can be CSV (diffusion tubes, schools) or RData (sensor data). Prepends DATA_PATH if set.

    data_ids

    Character vector of layer IDs (default: NULL, auto-generated from filenames).

    data_symbols

    Character vector of marker symbols, one per layer (default: NULL — layer shape metadata, else the automatic cycle). Accepts the friendly names "circle", "diamond", "cross", "square", "triangle", "star", "plus" and every renderer symbol name (18 in all; an unknown name errors with the full list).

    data_dynamic

    Logical vector indicating temporal (TRUE) vs static (FALSE) layers (default: NULL, auto-detected).

    output_file

    Output file name, used verbatim (include the .html extension). Saved to the 'aq_maps/' directory; NULL returns the widget without writing a file.

    export_image

    NULL (no export), TRUE (export 1200x1200), or c(width, height) vector for custom dimensions.

    boroughs

    Borough name(s) for boundary display. NULL (default) draws no boundary and fits the map to the data.

    pollutant

    Pollutant type: "no2" or "pm25" (default: "no2").

    display_times

    Time periods to display (e.g., "2023", "2023-01", "2023-01-15 10:00"). NULL uses all available periods from data. Must match year_str format in data.

    title

    Page title and banner text. Default: NULL (uses theme).

    vignette

    If TRUE, darkens areas outside borough(s). Default: NULL (uses theme).

    colour_scale

    Color scale name (default: "who_no2"). See load_colour_scale() for options.

    styling_type

    Controls banner/legend display: "html" (default) or "none".

    marker_labels

    Label visibility: FALSE, TRUE (hover), "values_on" (always), "labels" (custom/hover), "labels_on" (custom/always). Default: NULL (uses theme). Content: School/Label/pollutant columns.

    banner_colour

    Color for banner and vignette. Default: NULL (uses theme).

    boundary_labels

    If TRUE, shows borough boundary labels. Default: NULL (uses theme).

    autoplay

    Auto-start year animation on load. Default: NULL (uses theme).

    play_speed

    Milliseconds per time step during animation. Default: NULL, which uses the theme, and failing that a pace set by how many steps there are (1200ms for 12 or fewer, 800ms up to 60, 450ms above). The viewer can scale whatever this ends up being with the speed button on the map, from a quarter of it to eight times.

    theme_file

    Path to YAML theme file (default: NULL). See inst/themes/ for examples.

    wind

    Wind data for the particle overlay: a from_worldmet() object or a data frame of date/ws/wd. Interactive HTML only.

    Value

    Invisible Leaflet map object. Side effects: Saves HTML to aq_maps/. If export_image is not NULL, also saves JPG files (one per year).

    Details

    Data Files: CSV files (diffusion tubes, schools) require Easting/Northing columns. RData files (sensors) are searched for a compatible data.frame by column, whatever the object is called (see load_rdata_file()). School data auto-detected by School column.

    Coordinates: Input British National Grid (EPSG:27700), output WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

    Setup: Set Sys.setenv(DATA_PATH = "~/path/to/data") before use.

    Symbols: Auto-assigned by data type. Override with data_symbols parameter.

    Note

    Year columns in CSV files must be YYYY format (e.g., "2024"). Static JPG exports require Chrome/Chromium for webshot2.

    See also

    Other map: add_boundary_polygons(), create_pollution_map(), quickmap()

    Examples

    # Basic interactive map (annual)
Sys.setenv(DATA_PATH = "~/data")
create_pollution_map(
  data_sources = list("wandsworth_2017_2024.csv", "schools_Wandsworth.csv"),
  boroughs = "Wandsworth",
  display_times = "2024",
  output_file = "wandsworth_2024.html"
)
#> Warning: cannot open file '/Users/iarla/data/wandsworth_2017_2024.csv': No such file or directory
#> Error in file(file, "rt"): cannot open the connection

# Monthly data (sub-annual)
create_pollution_map(
  data_sources = list("sensor_monthly.Rdata"),
  boroughs = "Merton",
  display_times = c("2024-01", "2024-02", "2024-03"),
  output_file = "merton_q1_2024"
)
#> Warning: cannot open compressed file '/Users/iarla/data/sensor_monthly.Rdata', probable reason 'No such file or directory'
#> Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE): cannot open the connection
